WHAT: UserPromptSubmit hook fires on every user message submitted to Claude Code. Payload via stdin: `{session_id, prompt}`.

WHERE: `~/.claude/hooks/user-prompt.sh` + `src/app/api/hooks/user-prompt/route.ts`

HOW: Hook POSTs to server immediately. Server:
1. Quick fallback: `extractPromptTitle(prompt)` — strips markdown headers, grabs first meaningful sentence → broadcasts immediately
2. Async: spawn `claude -p` with last 4 user turns from JSONL as context → Haiku generates 3-8 word title → broadcasts when ready

WHY: User's own words are the best signal for current focus. 'fix the login bug' IS the title. No translation needed. For long plan dumps, LLM extracts the key phrase.

GOTCHA: Spawning `claude -p` from this endpoint causes recursion (UserPromptSubmit fires again). Fix: set `PIXEL_OFFICE_HAIKU=1` env var, check it in the hook script to skip execution.
